T:S1.1.text: Individual consumers performing do-it-yourself repairs and professional installers such as independent vehicle repair shops are both key buyers, and repair shops typically get parts through local independent wholesalers and national distributors.

T:S2.1.text: Dorman's products reach aftermarket retailers, regional and local warehouse distributors, specialty markets, and salvage yards under the Dorman brand and sub-brands such as OE Solutions, Help!, and HD Solutions.

C:S3.1.text: SMP's own materials say it supplies NAPA, AutoZone, O'Reilly, Federated and others, selling its products to warehouse distributors and auto parts retail chains, and it also makes private-label products for key customers.

C:S4.1.text: Standard Motor Products (SMP) sells mainly to the traditional aftermarket. Its core channels are program distribution groups, warehouse distributors, and major retailers, and it also serves original equipment manufacturers and OE service operations.

C:S5.1.text: SMP's core lines are premium replacement parts for the engine management and temperature control systems of motor vehicles.

C:S6.1.text: Products are sold under names including Standard, BWD Automotive, Blue Streak Automotive, Blue Streak Wire, TechSmart, Intermotor, Factory Air, and Four Seasons.

C:S7.1.text: Customers buy directly from SMP and distribute to their own outlets, jobber stores, professional shops and technicians, and do-it-yourselfers.
